title: Sodiboost
description: A silly mod about a silly fedizen
body:
# Sodiboost mod

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1362400131206348930?label=join%20luna's%20Discord%20server%20%3A3)](https://dcd.gg/luna)
[![Gitea Release](https://img.shields.io/gitea/v/release/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/releases)
[![Forgejo Issues](https://img.shields.io/gitea/issues/open/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/issues)
[![Forgejo Pull Requests](https://img.shields.io/gitea/pull-requests/open/luna/sodiboost?gitea_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgit.mldchan.dev)](https://git.mldchan.dev/luna/sodiboost/pulls)
[![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40luna%40fedi.mldchan.dev%20on%20fedi-ffaaff)
](https://fedi.mldchan.dev/users/luna)

This mod is an elaborate shitpost. It adds a few items, mostly related to [Sharkey](https://activitypub.software/TransFem-Org/Sharkey) boosts and a fedizen named [Sodiboo](https://gaysex.cloud/@sodiboo). They are infamous on the fediverse for boosting absolutely every single post.

## Items

- The Sodiboo block - The base of this mod. Currently it doesn't naturally generate, that's planned together with animations for 1.1.0.
- Sodiboost item - Dropped from the Sodiboo block, can be used to craft a few items.
- The Sodiboost block - Not to be confused with the Sodiboo block
- An "Instance Moment" painting - This is the result of what happens when Sodiboo boosts all of your posts on your fedi instance. Peak 100% CPU moment.
- Sodiboost dimension, where all block are Sodiboo's.
- The Sodiboo biome, only spawning in the Sodiboost dimension.
- The Sodiboost igniter
- Sodiboost Liquid in the new dimension

## Recipes

Here are a few recipes used to craft the items:

- A painting recipe to get the "Instance Moment" painting can be crafted like this
  
  ![3x3 Minecraft  crafting grid fully filled up with Sodiboo items, the result is a painting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bd762ba8784cbc49f5b1a459218b3e4b7501bf6.png)
- A Sodiboost Block recipe
  
  ![3x3 crafting menu with only the 2x2 region the bottom right filled out with Sodiboost items. The result is 4 Sodiboo blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d858baf80178c2ec1ce1689a644b7c84bc1a43f9.png)
- Sodiboost portal igniter
  
  ![A 3x3 recipe showing a flint and one Sodiboost item in the crafting grid. The result is a "Sodiboost Dimension Portal Igniter"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1908c670f2995f187eaa6e9489deec5f046243af.png)

## What is Sharkey? (Unrelated to the mod)

Sharkey is a federated social network software forked from Misskey. It builds on top of Misskey. You can [find a Sharkey instance and check it out](https://sharkey.fediverse.observer) or [start your own Sharkey instance](https://docs.joinsharkey.org/docs/install/fresh).

The fediverse is a collection of social networks interconnected using a common protocol. Here belong [Mastodon](https://joinmastodon.org/), [Misskey](https://misskey-hub.net/en/), [Sharkey](https://joinsharkey.org/), [Friendica](https://friendi.ca/), [Akkoma](https://akkoma.dev/AkkomaGang/akkoma/), [Pleroma](https://pleroma.social/), [Iceshrimp](https://iceshrimp.dev/), [GoToSocial](https://gotosocial.org/) and many more.
